boundaries: All vehicles and hours are invented model inputs, not a Texas deployment estimate.
Available hours exclude assumed downtime; occupied share is the part carrying passengers; remaining available hours include unoccupied activity.
Trip duration held constant; actual peak demand, repositioning, route/ODD constraints and support events could change output.
Allocated cost pool has only declared vehicle-day and overhead inputs; no complete profitability or fare projection.
Trip is a completed occupied vehicle trip; no occupancy, passenger-journey or unique-user multiplication assumed.

updateTriggers: Austin current admission or Explorers access changes; a new dated service milestone replaces a plan.
Dallas or Houston reports a changed local vehicle/test/public-service stage.
Current Federal Register grant or Operational Authorization conditions change.
Actual local depot scope, lease, charging/power readiness, vendor contract or fleet allocation becomes available.
Current app distribution, service area, operating hours, fares or rider support changes.
Observed or contracted fleet hours, occupied share, trip durations, demand and costs replace hypothetical inputs.
